title: Reports Indicate ChatGPT Service Disruption and Restoration
description: Users globally reported issues with ChatGPT, with OpenAI later restoring service.

ChatGPT down: Users are facing issues with login, chats and more across web and app

sections.heading: Service Disruption
paragraphs: ChatGPT, an AI-powered chatbot by OpenAI, experienced a global outage affecting its API and Codex, as reported by Unite.AI.

sections.heading: Reports of Issues
paragraphs: Users faced difficulties with login, chats, and other functionalities across the web and app, as stated by Moneycontrol.com.

sections.heading: Service Restoration
paragraphs: OpenAI restored ChatGPT's function after acknowledging the issues, according to Yahoo Finance UK.

faq.q: What was the issue with ChatGPT?
faq.a: ChatGPT faced a global outage affecting login, chats, and other functionalities.
Yes, OpenAI restored ChatGPT's function after the disruption.
